blocks.text: Langley houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Langley peaked at 520 in September 2025 and bottomed at 314 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in May 2026 with 90. The reported sale price moved from $1,432,950 to $1,345,000, a change of −6.1%.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Langley?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 449 houses listed in Langley and 64 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Langley?
faq.a: The September report gave $1,345,000 for houses in Langley, against $1,315,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Langley?
faq.a: The September report showed 20 days on market for houses in Langley and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 23 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Langley?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Langley?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
